methods.notes: Only Felicita name candidates enter the post-connect service and first-frame checks; vendor exact-name matching can miss Arc variants.

identification.notes: Automatic identity uses only a case-insensitive Felicita name prefix. FFE0 is deliberately absent from identification/discovery because matcher axes are OR-combined and this widely reused UUID would match unrelated devices without the name. Require FFE0/FFE1 after connection instead.

device.name: Felicita Arc
device.notes:
Phone-direct BLE weight and battery telemetry plus tare and timer commands. No account, cloud brew history or Wi-Fi path is required. Scope is Arc only: Parallel, non-S Pearl and other Felicita models are not claimed compatible, and Acaia's different protocol is not reused.
Consumer integration is identify_only: no dedicated Arc handler ships here. The protocol blocks and stdlib vectors are implementation evidence, not live app telemetry or controls. Supported status requires a handler that enforces the name, post-connect service and first-frame gates before tare/timer.
Notifications on FFE1 are exactly 18 bytes. Byte 2 is ASCII '-' (0x2d) for a negative weight; any other value leaves the magnitude positive. Bytes 3-8 must all be ASCII digits and form an integer in hundredths of a gram. Other bytes are reserved/unknown and are preserved, not assigned a checksum.
Battery byte 15 has a bounded encoding: raw 129 maps to 0% and raw 158 to 100%, with round((raw-129)*100/29) between. Values outside that interval are UNKNOWN, not 0% or 100%; retain the last valid battery reading or null initially. Reject short/long notifications and non-digit weight fields.

openness.notes: Protocol recovered in a public open client and checked against public app behavior; no vendor wire specification was found.

enter_pairing_mode.notes: No pairing button or bonding exchange is used by the open client.

exclusivity.recovery: Close the other app, disconnect, then wake and reconnect the scale; GATT 133 recovery timing remains host policy.

unpair.notes: There is no bond to revoke; disconnect only.

credentials.notes: No credential is used by the documented weight, tare or timer path.

factory_reset.description: No manual-backed reset was acquired. Do not treat tare, timer reset, disconnecting or power-cycling as a factory reset.
factory_reset.effect: No factory-reset procedure or cleared-state list was established. Display sleep/disconnect is not a reset.

methods.description: Connect a Felicita name candidate without pairing, verify FFE0/FFE1 and wait for a valid 18-byte notification before any tare/timer write.
methods.name: Direct BLE with service and first-frame validation

steps.action: Wake the scale and close any other app connected to it.
Connect only a Felicita name candidate and enumerate services; continue only if 0000ffe0-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb and FFE1 exist.
Subscribe to FFE1 notifications and discard malformed packets until one valid 18-byte frame arrives.
steps.expect: A weight and a valid or explicitly unknown battery state; readiness must not depend on clamping an invalid battery byte.

steps.action: Only a future dedicated handler may issue a user-invoked tare/timer write, and only after the name, post-connect service and valid-first-frame gates all pass; use write-with-response.
steps.expect: No command is sent to a service-only match or before first-frame validation. The one-byte command is acknowledged at GATT level; no timer response payload is assumed.

causes: Another central holds the scale; close it and reconnect.
Frames are malformed or the wrong model is connected; verify exact length, digits and FFE0/FFE1.
The plugin's two-second silence watchdog is provisional host policy, not a measured device timeout; do not hard-code it as protocol fact.
troubleshooting.symptom: Weight never becomes ready or repeatedly disconnects.

setup.notes: No provisioning, account, bond or application key. Connect a name candidate, verify FFE0, subscribe and wait for one valid frame before exposing readings or commands.

rejoin.notes: BLE only: disconnect the previous central and reconnect; no scale-to-phone bond or Wi-Fi network exists.

steps.action: Disconnect the old client and wake/reconnect the scale.
Verify FFE0/FFE1 and wait for a new valid frame before issuing another command.

testing.notes: No scale, radio capture or command was used by this project. All bytes are reported from the public Reaprime driver and its defensive plugin; synthetic vectors in scripts/test_felicita_arc_spec.py check the stated parser, including malformed lengths/digits and battery endpoints.

entities.name: Weight
entities.notes: Decoded by protocol_details.arc_frame from exact 18-byte notifications.

entities.name: Battery
entities.notes: Only raw 129..158 produces a value; invalid raw values retain the last valid state or remain unknown.

evidence.app_static_analysis: Public vendor-app review corroborated the FFE0/FFE1 roles and exact-name scanning. Standard Battery Service declarations in the app do not establish that an Arc exposes 0x180f/0x2a19, so neither is declared.
evidence.open_questions: Capture actual notifications, write properties and reconnect behavior. Parallel and non-S Pearl require independent evidence.
evidence.public_implementation: Reaprime at b4acf861051607464976c6c237add448604bb681 supplied the Arc GATT map, 18-byte layout and one-byte commands. Its opt-in plugin supplied the stricter length/digit validation and last-valid battery behavior used here.

helpful_urls.description: Open Arc driver, defensive plugin, 18-byte parser and tare/timer commands used by this spec.
helpful_urls.title: tadelv/reaprime (pinned Felicita Arc implementation)

initialization.notes: Subscribe before tare/timer commands and wait for one valid frame before marking the scale ready.

algorithm: Require len(frame) == 18 and every frame[3:9] byte to be an ASCII digit.
magnitude = ASCII frame[3:9] parsed as a base-10 integer; weight_g = magnitude / 100.
If frame[2] == 0x2d (ASCII '-'), negate weight_g. Other sign-byte values leave it positive, matching both public parsers.
If 129 <= frame[15] <= 158, battery_percent = round((frame[15]-129)*100/29). Otherwise retain the last valid value, or null if none exists.
Publish a weight only from a valid frame. Battery out of range does not invalidate that weight, but it must not create a fake endpoint percentage.

command_gate.automatic_identity: Case-insensitive Felicita local-name prefix only; FFE0 is never an automatic discovery/identification axis.
command_gate.handler: Future dedicated Arc handler only; generic consumers remain identify_only and send no command.

arc_frame.description: Exactly 18 bytes. Bytes 0-1 and 9-14, 16-17 have no established meaning; preserve them and do not invent a checksum. A notification with any other length is ignored. All six bytes at offsets 3-8 must be 0x30..0x39.

vectors.provenance: Synthetic valid frame with reserved bytes chosen for the fixture.

remaining_unknowns: Meanings of all reserved bytes and whether any standard Battery Service exists beside frame byte 15.
Actual notification cadence, the plugin's provisional two-second silence timeout and GATT write properties.
Zero/negative-weight edge cases, battery endpoints and reconnect after display sleep on hardware.
Factory reset, firmware update, a low-power command and support for Parallel or non-S Pearl.

tare.description: Tare/zero the scale (ASCII T, one byte).

timer_reset.description: Reset the scale timer (ASCII C, one byte).

timer_start.description: Start the scale timer (ASCII R, one byte).

timer_stop.description: Stop the scale timer (ASCII S, one byte).

values.45: negative; any other value leaves magnitude positive

format.name: weight_digits
format.notes: Exactly six ASCII digits; integer hundredths of a gram (value = integer / 100 g).

format.name: battery_raw
format.notes: 129..158 only; decode round((raw-129)*100/29) percent. Outside the interval is unknown, never clamped.

characteristics.name: Weight/battery notifications and tare/timer writes
characteristics.notes: One characteristic serves both directions. The format below exposes raw fields; use protocol_details.arc_frame for exact-length, ASCII, sign, scaling and last-valid-battery behavior. Use write-with-response for commands; on-air write-property confirmation is still needed.

services.name: Felicita Arc data service
services.notes: The service must be verified after connection because this 16-bit UUID is shared by many unrelated devices.
